definition-dropped.flag: character | in a coded character set (newer: undefined); character | in a screen item (newer: undefined); character | in cobol character repertoire (newer: undefined); character | in computer storage (newer: undefined); coded character set (newer: undefined)
definition-dropped.answer: §2002:4 defines 'character' in four senses (in a coded character set, in a screen item, in the COBOL character repertoire, in computer storage) and 'coded character set' as "A set of unambiguous rules that establishes a character set" (taken from ISO/IEC 10646-1); 2023 drops these entries and takes the terms from its normative reference ISO/IEC 10646 (§2023:2), in the same sense. GR3 uses 'character' (the character zero) in that ordinary sense; the numeric, boolean and character contexts it governs in 2002 are unchanged and covered by the reader's evidence at --std 2002.
